# Style Checks v1.0
# Comprehensive style and formatting validation framework for prompt governance

style_checks:
  version: "1.0"
  last_updated: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  
  # Style validation framework
  validation_framework:
    automated_checks:
      yaml_structure:
        - name: "yaml_syntax_validation"
          description: "Validate YAML syntax and structure"
          checks:
            - syntax_correctness: "Parse YAML without errors"
            - proper_indentation: "Consistent 2-space indentation"
            - required_fields: "All mandatory fields present"
            - data_type_consistency: "Field types match schema"
          severity: "critical"
          
        - name: "naming_convention_compliance"
          description: "Ensure consistent naming conventions"
          checks:
            - snake_case_keys: "All keys use snake_case format"
            - consistent_casing: "Uniform case usage throughout"
            - descriptive_names: "Clear, descriptive fi
